explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/756: can an n-point set in ℝ² have ≫ n distinct distances each occurring for more than n pairs? Yes (Bhowmick: ⌊n/4⌋ such distances). maxRichDistances n is the max number of distances with multiplicity ≥ n + 1, and the statement asserts n = O(maxRichDistances n). Faithful.
